expectations.text: Creates all three baseline docs: README.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md
README documents only commands that exist in the repo (pip install -e ., ruff/pytest, imgtools resize/convert)
AGENTS.md documentation map links only to Markdown files that exist
No invented facts: no license claims, badges, or repo URLs absent from the repo
CONTRIBUTING.md links to README for setup instead of duplicating install commands
